newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton steady in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton steady in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady in dull trade on Tuesday as spinners stayed on the sidelines while ginners resisted any cut in prices, dealers said.

Spinners have almost halted buying since the government slashed duties on import of raw cotton and synthetic fibres on Saturday as part of a relief package for the textile industry, dealer Asif Naseem said.
"Ginners are resisting any cut in prices in anticipation of demand from exporters," he said. "But if exporters also remain quiet we may see prices falling sharply."
